Public libraries of Bangladesh & empower users with an extensive collection of resources at their fingertips designed to make learning accessible to everyone. Features You'll Love: - Access thousands of books, magazines, and journals in Bengali, English, and other languages. From fiction to non-fiction, research materials to textbooks – everything is just a click away. - Register for a library membership or manage your existing account directly through the app. - Check the availability of books and borrow physical copies at your nearest government public library. - Online delivery service for membership cards & borrowed books. - Inter-library book transfer request to get any specific book in the nearest library. - Our easy-to-navigate design ensures a smooth browsing experience for users of all ages. - Quickly find what you're looking for by title, author, genre, or publication year. - Enjoy reading directly within the app with our in-built e-book reader with bookmarking features. - Stay informed about library events or special programs hosted by the Government Public Library. - Get important notice directly from the mobile app. - Based on your reading history, get curated suggestions to expand your knowledge and discover new interests. - Publishers can directly apply for their books to sell. - Protect your data with our advanced security measures, ensuring safe and private access to your library account. Who Is This App For? - Students preparing for academic exams or research. - Professionals seeking knowledge for career advancement. - Book enthusiasts exploring literature and new genres. - Job seekers reading newspapers & professional books to enhance their knowledge. Why Choose the Centralized Library App? - Centralized Government Public Library: Direct integration ensures reliability and credibility. - Free Access to Knowledge: A step towards making learning accessible for everyone. - 24/7 Availability: Access the library anytime, anywhere. How to Get Started? - Download the app and register using your Full Name, Phone No, Email, gender & Date of Birth. - Verify your registration & login with phone no & password. - Start exploring the extensive library collection! Join the Knowledge Revolution With the Centralized Library App, we aim to make knowledge and learning accessible to every citizen of Bangladesh, breaking the barriers of time and location. Whether you’re a student, researcher, or casual reader, this app is your ultimate companion in the journey of discovery and enlightenment.
